integration_issues.issue: Query param 'komponen' embedded via template string without encodeURIComponent. '+' character in 'Recovery (Kol.4+5)' is decoded to space by the server → whitelist check fails → HTTP 400 (also visible in browser as red 'Uncaught runtime error' overlay from Axios). Fixed by testing agent in Leaderboard.js:17 & Compare.js:32 using encodeURIComponent(komponen). Please review and keep fix.

action_items: Review the two-line frontend fix applied by testing agent (encodeURIComponent for komponen param) in /app/frontend/src/pages/Leaderboard.js and /app/frontend/src/pages/Compare.js — this unblocks the new Recovery (Kol.4+5) leaderboard tab.
Consider auditing all other places that manually construct query strings for values that may contain reserved characters (+, &, #, spaces) — prefer axios params object over template literals.
critical_code_review_comments: Leaderboard.js/Compare.js used naked template-literal query strings for user-supplied komponen — a class-of-bug: `${komponen}` never gets URL-encoded so any '+', '&', '#' in future component names will silently break. Migrate to axios `params: { komponen, periode }` object across all api.get calls to eliminate this category.

backend routers/views.py:63 & 78 whitelist for komponen is hard-coded — consider extracting the list to a single constants file (also used by calc.COMPONENT_MAP) so adding a 5th component in future only requires editing one place.

calc.py build_riwayat C&R branch always emits target_kol45/realisasi_kol45/achievement_kol45/status_kol45 fields for ALL 12 months, even months where user is not C&R historically — currently fine because same user is CR throughout, but if role changes mid-year the columns would still show for months when the user wasn't CR. Consider gating by user role at that month.

Riwayat.js `hasKol45 = rows.some((r) => 'realisasi_kol45' in r)` reveals kol45 columns as soon as ANY row has the field — correct for CR users, but for a role-change user this would leak kol45 columns for pre-role months. Minor.
Frontend period selector is now two dropdowns (period-month-filter + period-year-filter). Any legacy test using old data-testid 'period-filter' will silently no-op. Ensure obsolete tests are updated.

rca of the issue: Bug: Leaderboard tab 'Recovery (Kol.4+5)' returned HTTP 400. RCA: Leaderboard.js line 17 built URL via template literal `?komponen=${komponen}&…` with komponen='Recovery (Kol.4+5)'. The '+' character in URL query strings is defined by application/x-www-form-urlencoded to mean SPACE. FastAPI decoded komponen as 'Recovery (Kol.4 5)' which is not in the whitelist ('Pembiayaan','Funding','Recovery','Recovery (Kol.4+5)') so views.py line 63 raised HTTPException(400). Fix: wrap value in encodeURIComponent() so '+' becomes '%2B'. Same fix applied to Compare.js line 32. Verified fixed: leaderboard call now hits /api/leaderboard?komponen=Recovery%20(Kol.4%2B5)&periode=2026-09 → 200 with expected rows.
